note: How each scene folder under ~/goat-rig/rt2-scenes on the 5900X was exported (debug.rt_export, HALO_RT_EXPORT). Run from a checkout with the export branch built on the rig; check no player's game is running first.

c20_corner.build: local/rt2-export-tangents (rt2/export with tangents; any build with rt_export)
c20_corner.command: tools/rig/goat-rig @5900x run rt2x-c20 --build <ref> --shared --size 1920x1080 --seconds 30 -- 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST=campaign:levels\c20\c20' HALO_NETWORK_TEST_START=2 HALO_SKIP_CINEMATICS=1 HALO_GRAPHICS=classic HALO_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS=classic HALO_SHADOWS=classic HALO_NET_BROADCAST=127.255.255.255 HALO_FRAME_TIME=0.0333333333 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST_PLACE=-26.65 15.71 -4.6 -70 -8@8' 'HALO_NETWORK_TEST_CUES=5 ai_erase_all|5.1 render_shadows 0|9 debug_object_place "characters\floodcombat_human\floodcombat_human -25.42 12.33 -4.5 110"|10 show_hud 0' 'HALO_TEST_INPUT=script:12.5-13 flashlight' 'HALO_RT_EXPORT=14.5 /home/<user>/goat-rig/rt2-scenes/c20_corner_new'
c20_corner.then: move c20_corner_new into place as c20_corner (keep the previous as c20_corner_prev until the new one's counts and its overlay with original.png check out)
